description: An agent run's assignment (<step records>/runs/<run>/assignment.json; the run and its step are in the path): who it is, its sandbox and git context, the session it continues, what it was given and may write, and what reproduces its prompt. Never a credential.

model.description: the model the run asked for (config models; null: the agent CLI's default)

effort.description: the effort the run asked for (null: the CLI's default)
